terminus.generatedLayer: MUTHER proposes that field synthesis should preserve two non-substitutable channels: interpretive compression and interactional trace. A concept-rich account can overcompress the event; a chronology-rich account can under-model it. Combining them should not average them into one summary but keep the tension visible.
